notable_absence.finding: No role/privilege is stated in this page's Prerequisites for creating a Search index alias - only 'Search Service enabled', 'at least one Search index already created', and 'logged in to the Capella UI'. This matches the notable_absence already logged for the server/ counterpart of this page (server/search/create-search-index-alias.json), and is consistent with the same gap found on cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json and cloud/search/create-search-index-ui.json in this same batch.

cross_product_finding: This is the third of three Capella search/ pages in this batch (create-search-indexes, create-search-index-ui, create-search-index-alias) with no documented privilege/role/credential-type requirement for creating Search indexes or aliases. See the fuller cross_product_finding logged in cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json for the full reasoning: this contrasts with (a) server/'s create-search-index-ui.json, which requires a 'Search Admin' role, and (b) this batch's cloud/vector-index/ pages, which require a Capella management-plane role (requiresCapellaRole) to create an index. Worth flagging as a possible genuine access-control inconsistency between Capella's Search Service and Vector Index feature areas, not just a docs gap.
